question: Should the release line accept this environment-gated durable runtime and its five public read-only Gateway inspection methods as the supported PR4 boundary?
rationale: The change establishes new persistent shared-state ownership, a public Gateway protocol family, CLI surface, and an opt-in environment contract; implementation review cannot determine whether maintainers want to sponsor that product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor inspection-only PR4
options.body: Approve the read-only boundary after the plugin SDK contract is restored and exact-head fresh-install, upgrade, and live inspection proof is attached.

options.title: Split the stack further
options.body: Land the persistent runtime and delivery foundations separately before reviewing public CLI and Gateway inspection APIs.

options.title: Defer the public surface
options.body: Keep durable inspection internal until the full lifecycle and release-line ownership model is settled.

recommendation.title: Sponsor inspection-only PR4
recommendation.body: Approve the read-only boundary after the plugin SDK contract is restored and exact-head fresh-install, upgrade, and live inspection proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal connects this person to the plugin SDK facade and adjacent core architecture affected by the decision.
